# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub private reporting](https://github.com/chopsticks-user/taskie/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the
taskie and Claude Code versions you used.

## Supported versions

Only the latest plugin version (`version` in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` on
`main`) gets security fixes. Installed copies pick up a fix
when the plugin updates.
